# Coverage — Snapshot Parse Across Dart Versions & Architectures

Every registered corpus sample present locally, parsed end-to-end (ELF ->
snapshot -> cluster alloc+fill -> instructions table -> disassembly). A clean
parse across a version/arch means aotopsy models that snapshot format with
**zero unknown-CID / cluster-desync errors**. Generated by `make coverage`
(commit `e2ca92f`, 2026-08-26).

**91 sample builds across 23 Dart versions parse cleanly on both
architectures; 0 failures.**

Snapshot support is structure-based (the header carries a git-derived hash, not
a version number). Dart 3.13's serialization cluster set (49 clusters, incl. the
new `Bytecode`/`ApiError`/`UnwindError`/`LocalVarDescriptors`) is fully
recognized — verified against `runtime/vm/app_snapshot.cc@3.13.2` and by the
clean 3.13.0 parse below.

## Method

- Iterates `samplecorpus.Registry`; for each sample present on disk, runs the
  full `LoadContext` pipeline and records success + recovered function count.
- A format aotopsy did not model would raise `unknown CID` and appear as ❌.
- Reproduce: `make coverage` (some versions have multiple build variants under
  one version/arch cell; the max function count is shown).
- Ground-truth name accuracy for the unstripped builds: see [BENCHMARK.md](BENCHMARK.md).
